top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards the conception and construction of IceCube together with the secure discovery of a diffuse flux of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos, a detector-plus-discovery achievement that opened a new observational window; the citation is confined to the diffuse flux and the instrument, avoiding the still-maturing source associations. The two-name Halzen and Karle allocation is discretionary given the collaboration, AMANDA and Baikal precursors and Yoshida, which is why P001 is a close and fully defensible second: optical lattice clocks have the cleanest attribution and no one disputes maturity. A prize is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: Profile records PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+ and XL-Calibur connections and an astroparticle background adjacent to IceCube; no documented tie to Halzen, Karle or Yoshida or to Katori or Ye. Field proximity is a possible bias for P002 but not an apparent recusal ground.
